prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) did not help, resulting in one worse outcome and one with no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as sign-in reordering, adoption flows, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the impact of winning tests like path selection redesign and initial path copy reframing.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Pet Personality and Trait Selector: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split layout separating personality behavior choices from visual appearance presets. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 65.9% with mean duration reaching 1017 seconds, showing users get stuck balancing look and trait options.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Reorders onboarding to place account creation directly after adoption certificate completion rather than before pet customization. (why: Support tickets highlight 8 complaints about pets missing after signing in; moving sign-in right after pet creation connects account backup with the completed pet.)
2: [home, layout] Centered Minimalist Waiting Screen Status: Transforms the waiting screen into a centered layout with dynamic visual progress indicators. (why: Home waiting stage has a median duration of 201 seconds and mean 2336 seconds; clearer layout feedback reduces anxiety during generation.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Official Companion Adoption Certificate Stamp Badge: Adds an official adoption seal and completion badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: 34.1% of users drop during adoption; adding reward framing elevates emotional milestone completion.)
4: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Welcome Companion Overview: Redesigns home intro screen to spotlight layout featuring quick desktop interaction guidance. (why: 35.2% of users fail to complete finish stage (mean 5815s) and 3 support tickets report pet desktop visibility or control confusion.)
5: [sign_in, redesign] Two-Column Account Sync Reassurance Layout: Redesigns sign-in screen into a split two-column format detailing automatic pet cloud backups. (why: 27.1% sign-in drop-off and 8 support tickets regarding lost/reset pets after re-authenticating.)

scores.note: Adoption stage loses 34.1% of users with long durations; adoption redesigns historically yield positive results (+2.3%).
Strong evidence from funnel and 8 support tickets, but sign-in reordering previously saw a steep drop (-7.1%).
Home step loses 18.7% with long wait times, but past waiting screen and home layout changes showed neutral to negative lift.
Targets high adoption drop-off (34.1%), but badge additions lack direct historical benchmark.
Finish drops 35.2% and support mails confirm user confusion; previous finish redesign showed +2.1% lift.
Both support mails (8 tickets) and funnel point to sign-in drop-off, though sign-in layout tweaks typically produce modest effects.
